indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: An entity is a Canadian small or medium-size import/export company, wholesaler, dealer or broker operating in a sector dealing in high-volume, high-demand commodities with variable price ranges, including agri-food, textiles, electronics, toys, lumber and paper, and automotive or heavy equipment.
indicators.red_flag: High-volume variable-price commodity import/export company (TBML-vehicle sector profile)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: The entity has business activities or a business model that is outside the norm for its sector, or conducts no business activities in Canada. It may also be difficult to confirm the exact nature of the business.
indicators.red_flag: Business model out-of-norm for sector / no Canadian operations (opaque-purpose entity)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: The entity transacts with a large number of entities that have activities in the above-noted sectors or have names that suggest activities in a wide range of unrelated sectors
indicators.red_flag: Counterparty fan-out across unrelated-sector entities (TBML network breadth)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: orders electronic funds transfers to the benefit of China- or Hong Kong-based trading companies or individuals, receives a sudden inflow of large-value electronic funds transfers; and receives electronic funds transfers from the U.S. and Latin American countries;
indicators.red_flag: EFTs out to China/Hong Kong trading firms, inbound from US/Latin America (corridor pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: orders electronic funds transfers to the benefit of entities or individuals in the U.S., Mexico or Latin American countries, and receives such transfers from the U.S.;
indicators.red_flag: EFTs to US/Mexico/Latin-America beneficiaries with reciprocal US inflows (corridor round-tripping)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: orders or receives electronic funds transfers to/from entities holding a bank account in Latvia or Cyprus, and are registered to addresses in the U.K., Cyprus, the British Virgin Islands, Panama, the Seychelles, Belize, the Marshall Islands or other offshore financial centers; and
indicators.red_flag: EFTs to/from offshore-registered shell entities (Latvia/Cyprus accounts, secrecy-jurisdiction addresses)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D17 (Geographic / jurisdiction risk reference), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph
build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph
build_logic.route: Tier-2 network alert â AML investigations gate

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: orders or receives payments for goods in round figures or in increments of approximately US$50,000.
indicators.red_flag: Round-figure / ~US$50K-increment goods payments (price-decoupled value transfer)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D1.

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: A trading company based in the United Arab Emirates orders electronic funds transfers to the benefit of individuals or entities in Canada.
indicators.red_flag: UAE trading-company EFTs benefiting Canadian parties (high-risk-corridor inbound)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: An entity’s U.S. dollar business accounts held in Canada exhibit flow-through activity—that is, money is taken or transferred out of the account as quickly as it flows in.
indicators.red_flag: USD business-account flow-through (in-and-out pass-through, no balance retention)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: An entity imports currency (predominantly U.S. dollars) from Latin American countries.
indicators.red_flag: Physical USD currency import from Latin America (cash-placement corridor)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: An entity makes large business purchases by credit card, funded by overpayments.
indicators.red_flag: Large card purchases funded by credit-card overpayments (overpayment-credit laundering)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators of trade-based money laundering by professional money laundering netw
indicators.flag: An individual issues cheques, purchases drafts or orders electronic funds transfers through the account of a legal professional for trade-related payments.
indicators.red_flag: Trade payments routed through a legal professional's account (third-party trust-account channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D19.

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: receives a sudden inflow of large electronic funds transfers and cash deposits; this is followed by an increased outflow of electronic funds transfers, cheques and bank drafts made out to multiple unrelated third parties for loans or investments, or to the individual conducting the transaction;
indicators.red_flag: MSB sudden EFT+cash inflow then fan-out to unrelated third parties (layering pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: undertakes numerous currency exchanges involving Canadian and U.S. dollars and/or Euros;
indicators.red_flag: Numerous CAD/USD/EUR currency exchanges (FX-churn placement)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: carries out business largely with or through Iran or other countries subject to sanctions, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Hong Kong, and China or countries with internal capital controls; and
indicators.red_flag: Business concentrated through sanctioned / capital-control jurisdictions (high-risk-corridor concentration)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: receives electronic funds transfers from foreign exchange and trading companies based in the above-noted countries for real estate transactions, loans or investments.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound EFTs from high-risk-jurisdiction FX/trading firms for real estate / loans / investments
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: maintains personal account activity similar to that of a money services business;
indicators.red_flag: Personal account exhibiting MSB-like activity (unregistered-MSB pattern)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: attempts to avoid reporting obligations when exchanging currency on behalf of another money services business;
indicators.red_flag: Report-trigger evasion when exchanging currency for another MSB (nested-MSB structuring)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: lists multiple occupations, addresses and/or telephone numbers with financial institutions or online;
indicators.red_flag: Multiple declared occupations / addresses / phone numbers across FIs (identity-obfuscation)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a customer whose KYC record shows integrity gaps or non-cooperation â overdue EDD documents, refused or evasive responses to information requests, or unresolved inconsistencies â escalating when cooperation failures persist past defined deadlines.
build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review & EDD gate

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: lists occupation as immigration consultant, student, homemaker or unemployed;
indicators.red_flag: Low-income declared occupation inconsistent with activity (occupation-vs-activity mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: lives outside of their reasonable means (i.e., buys real estate beyond what they could reasonably afford on their claimed income);
indicators.red_flag: Lifestyle / property purchases beyond declared income (means-vs-income mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: attempts to close an account(s) to avoid due diligence questioning;
indicators.red_flag: Account closure to evade due-diligence questioning (KYC non-cooperation)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a customer whose KYC record shows integrity gaps or non-cooperation â overdue EDD documents, refused or evasive responses to information requests, or unresolved inconsistencies â escalating when cooperation failures persist past defined deadlines.
build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review & EDD gate

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: receives wires and transfers from multiple sources in accounts at numerous banks and credit unions; the individual then depletes these amounts through drafts payable to self or for real estate purchases;
indicators.red_flag: Multi-source inbound wires across many FIs then drawn down via self-drafts / property buys (funnel-in drawdown)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: places large structured cash deposits into the same account at multiple locations on the same day; and
indicators.red_flag: Same-day structured cash deposits at multiple branch locations (geographic structuring)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: is a customer at many banks and credit unions, and negotiates many self-addressed bank drafts from various financial institutions.
indicators.red_flag: Customer at many FIs negotiating numerous self-addressed bank drafts (multi-institution draft cycling)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: receives one or two large electronic funds transfers and then orders multiple outgoing cheques and drafts to multiple third-party individuals and companies; and
indicators.red_flag: Import/export firm: few large EFTs in then many cheques/drafts out to third parties (MSB-like fan-out)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of professional money laundering through money services businesses
indicators.flag: receives large incoming electronic funds transfers from Iran, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Hong Kong and China for living costs, expenses or spare parts.
indicators.red_flag: Large inbound EFTs from high-risk jurisdictions tagged living-costs / spare-parts (corridor inflow with thin-purpose memo)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).
